message:
The PoC looks good. Now let me check the security bits calculation. For a 512-bit DH prime, `BN_security_bits` should return less than 80 bits.

Let me check the `BN_security_bits` function:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "BN_security_bits" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/crypto/bn/bn_lib.c | head -5; echo "---"; sed -n '/int BN_security_bits/,/^}/p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/crypto/bn/bn_lib.c</parameter>
